status: ACTIVE — this is the dataset the application loads and the one that travels in the repository
supersedes: dataset-v2 (_dataset), frozen and untouched as the historical reference of everything published before 2026-08-29
ships_as: seed/dataset — 19 files copied by a whitelist (pipeline/src/data_tools/export_seed_dataset.py); _private/ never leaves this directory

contents._doc: Two stages, two sets of figures, and they are NOT interchangeable: `extraction` is what build_all.py read out of the professional's documents, `normalized` is what the E1 chain (parse_items, build_food_catalog, normalize_diets) leaves behind and what the application actually loads. Quoting an extraction figure next to a normalized one is what makes the counts look as if 92 diets went missing.

normalized._doc: Measured on this directory on 2026-09-08. These are the figures the loaded application reports.

resolved_defects: build_food_catalog promoted ~10 instruction strings to canonical foods once the AGUA slot was read. CORRECTED before activation, in the code (build_food_catalog.looks_like_a_food_name), and this directory is built with the fix: the catalogue holds 228 canonical foods and none has the shape of a sentence (the check in V3_ACTIVATION.md section 0 prints an empty list). Rebuilding the v2 catalogue with and without the guard yields the same file, so the fix does not touch what was published from dataset-v2. The ten canonical foods the v3 adds over the v2 are listed one by one in docs/data/V2_VS_V3.md section 5.
